cim_eredeti: Self-improving AI the key step towards AGI but safety is key: Z.ai founder
szoveg_eredeti:
Tang says RSI represents a ‘new paradigm’ of R&D that will accelerate AI development even more than it has been

The remarks underscore how AI companies in the US and China are both chasing the holy grail of recursive self-improvement (RSI), where increasingly powerful AI systems also become better at improving themselves in an ever-accelerating “loop”.
